It is the number one platform for containers; from Docker to Kubernetes to LXD, Ubuntu can run your containers at scale.
Fast, secure and simple, Ubuntu powers millions of PCs worldwide.

RUN |1 PYTHON_VERSION=3.14 /bin/sh -c python${PYTHON_VERSION} -m venv /opt/venv &&     /opt/venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip &&     /opt/venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade setuptools # buildkit
LABEL image.title=PyTorch + ROCm runtime image (NPI) image.version=10.0.0 npi.python_version=3.14 npi.amdgpu_family=device-all npi.rocm_version=10.0.0

RUN |12 PYTHON_VERSION=3.14 ROCM_VERSION=10.0.0 AMDGPU_FAMILY=device-all RELEASE_TYPE=nightly INDEX_URL=https://stable.repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-next EXTRA_INDEX_URL= PIN_EXPLICIT_VERSIONS=true TORCH_VERSION=2.13.0+rocm10.0.0 TORCHAUDIO_VERSION= TORCHVISION_VERSION=0.28.0+rocm10.0.0 APEX_VERSION= TRITON_VERSION= /bin/sh -c /opt/venv/bin/python -m pip install         "cxxfilt>=0.2.0"         "tqdm>=4.28.1"         numpy         "PyYAML>=5.1"         "pytest>=3.5.1"         "packaging>=14.0"         "matplotlib>=3.8"         "pandas>=2.2.2"         py-cpuinfo         build         ninja         wheel # buildkit

RUN |12 PYTHON_VERSION=3.14 ROCM_VERSION=10.0.0 AMDGPU_FAMILY=device-all RELEASE_TYPE=nightly INDEX_URL=https://stable.repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-next EXTRA_INDEX_URL= PIN_EXPLICIT_VERSIONS=true TORCH_VERSION=2.13.0+rocm10.0.0 TORCHAUDIO_VERSION= TORCHVISION_VERSION=0.28.0+rocm10.0.0 APEX_VERSION= TRITON_VERSION= /bin/sh -c set -eu;     PIN_EXPLICIT_FLAG="";     if [ "${PIN_EXPLICIT_VERSIONS}" = "true" ]; then PIN_EXPLICIT_FLAG="--pin-explicit-versions"; fi;     /opt/venv/bin/python /tmp/install_pytorch_wheels.py         --no-break-system-packages         --skip-verify         --device-targets "${AMDGPU_FAMILY}"         --index-url "${INDEX_URL}"         ${EXTRA_INDEX_URL:+--extra-index-url "${EXTRA_INDEX_URL}"}         --amdgpu-family "${AMDGPU_FAMILY}"         ${ROCM_VERSION:+--rocm-version "${ROCM_VERSION}"}         ${PIN_EXPLICIT_FLAG}         ${TORCH_VERSION:+--torch-version "${TORCH_VERSION}"}         ${TORCHAUDIO_VERSION:+--torchaudio-version "${TORCHAUDIO_VERSION}"}         ${TORCHVISION_VERSION:+--torchvision-version "${TORCHVISION_VERSION}"}         ${APEX_VERSION:+--apex-version "${APEX_VERSION}"}         ${TRITON_VERSION:+--triton-version "${TRITON_VERSION}"} # buildkit

RUN |12 PYTHON_VERSION=3.14 ROCM_VERSION=10.0.0 AMDGPU_FAMILY=device-all RELEASE_TYPE=nightly INDEX_URL=https://stable.repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-next EXTRA_INDEX_URL= PIN_EXPLICIT_VERSIONS=true TORCH_VERSION=2.13.0+rocm10.0.0 TORCHAUDIO_VERSION= TORCHVISION_VERSION=0.28.0+rocm10.0.0 APEX_VERSION= TRITON_VERSION= /bin/sh -c /opt/venv/bin/python -c "import torch; import torchaudio; import torchvision; import apex; import triton; print('torch', torch.__version__); print('ROCm/HIP', torch.version.hip)" # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c mkdir -p /run/von-read /app/input /app/output && chmod 700 /run/von-read     && python3 -c "import sys,torch,transformers; assert sys.version_info[:2]==(3,14); assert torch.__version__=='2.13.0+rocm10.0.0'; assert torch.version.hip; assert transformers.__version__=='5.3.0'; from transformers import Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration"     && python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; from von_read.native_reader import verify_snapshot; verify_snapshot(Path('/models/reader'))" # buildkit
